Legends: which are open, and where

Source: R/mira_view.R
mira_legends.Rd

A plot opens with every legend minimized (a button "Expand ... Legend"). mira_legends() opens them: all of them, or the ones named in show. A legend appears only when its attribute is mapped (e.g. node_size needs mira_node(size_by = )). In MiRA, legends can still be expanded, minimized and dragged.

Usage

mira_legends(show = "all", position)

Arguments

show

"all" (default; TRUE is the same), the legends to open (the others stay minimized): "node_color", "node_size", "node_shape", "intralayer_color", "interlayer_color", "layer_color"; or FALSE to hide the legend panel (MiRA's legend button shows it again). With per-set colors or sizes, "node_color" and "node_size" open both sets' legends.

position

Where the legends are: "bottom-right" (MiRA's default), "top-right" or "bottom-left".

Value

A component, to add to a plot with +.

Details

These are the legends of network mode, which the grid and the map share. The meta-network and the layer view have their own legends, which start open: there, position and show = FALSE apply, and legend names in show do not. A legend describes the whole network, also when mira_filter() draws part of it.

A later mira_legends() changes only the arguments it gives: mira_legends(position = "top-right") moves the legends and leaves an earlier show as it was. With no earlier show it opens all of them, as mira_legends() does.

See also

Other components: mira_camera(), mira_filter(), mira_interlayer(), mira_intralayer(), mira_layer(), mira_layout(), mira_mode, mira_mode_dashboard(), mira_mode_data(), mira_mode_grid(), mira_mode_layer(), mira_mode_map(), mira_mode_meta(), mira_node()

Examples

library(emln)
net <- load_emln(17) # 4 layers; bird and plant nodes
#> Creating state node map
#> Creating extended link list with node IDs
p <- mira(net, bipartite = TRUE, setA_type = "bird") +
  mira_node(color_by = "verification_level", size_by = "intra_degree_sum") +
  mira_layer(color_by = "interaction_type")
#> Bipartite network: drawn as undirected. Use directed = TRUE for a directed one.

# Open every legend
p + mira_legends()
#> Not opened: R is not interactive. Print the plot in an R session, or give `browser` to open it from a script.

# Open two, at the top right
p + mira_legends(show = c("node_color", "layer_color"), position = "top-right")
#> Not opened: R is not interactive. Print the plot in an R session, or give `browser` to open it from a script.

# No legends
p + mira_legends(show = FALSE)
#> Not opened: R is not interactive. Print the plot in an R session, or give `browser` to open it from a script.
